              • Lane departure prevention - Keep it between the lines. It only takes a moment of inattention for your vehicle to drift. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.

Dual-zone climate control keeps everyone comfortable, and the telescoping steering wheel lets you dial in the perfect driving position. Leather trim on the steering wheel and shift knob add a touch of refinement to the cabin.

Electronic stability control works with traction control to help maintain grip, while anti-whiplash front head restraints and multiple airbags provide comprehensive protection. The low tire pressure warning system keeps you informed of your vehicle's condition, and the rear parking camera eliminates guesswork when reversing.

The Entune system keeps you connected and informed with real-time traffic, weather, fuel prices, and sports updates. Voice recognition and hands-free calling let you stay focused on the road, while Bluetooth music streaming and iPod connectivity mean your entertainment travels with you. Complimentary Entune services for three years add genuine value to your ownership experience.

This 4Runner represents Toyota's proven engineering and durability in a mid-size SUV platform. It's ready to handle whatever you ask of it—whether that's highway miles, off-road exploration, or family hauling duty. We invite you to schedule a test drive and experience this vehicle's capable character firsthand.

2016 Cadillac Escalade Luxury 4WD Vehicle DescriptionIntroduction

The 2016 Cadillac Escalade Luxury 4WD is a premium full-size luxury SUV that delivers commanding V8 performance, first-class comfort, advanced technology, and impressive capability. Known for its unmistakable Cadillac styling and upscale craftsmanship, the Escalade Luxury offers a refined driving experience with the versatility needed for families, road trips, towing, and everyday driving.

With its powerful 6.2-liter V8 engine, sophisticated Four-Wheel Drive system, premium leather interior, and extensive luxury features, the Escalade provides an exceptional combination of performance, comfort, and prestige.

Performance

  • Engine: 6.2-Liter V8

  • Horsepower: 420 HP

  • Torque: 460 lb-ft

  • Transmission: 8-Speed Automatic Transmission

  • Drivetrain: Four-Wheel Drive (4WD)

  • Magnetic Ride Control

  • Tow/Haul Mode

  • Trailer Sway Control

  • Maximum Towing Capacity: Up to 8,100 lbs when properly equipped

Under the hood, the Escalade Luxury is powered by Cadillac's impressive 6.2-liter V8 engine, producing 420 horsepower and 460 lb-ft of torque. The 8-speed automatic transmission provides smooth, confident acceleration and effortless highway cruising.

The 4WD system adds confidence in rain, snow, and changing road conditions, while Magnetic Ride Control continuously adjusts the suspension to provide an exceptionally smooth and composed ride.

Interior & Comfort

  • Seating for Up to 7 Passengers

  • Premium Leather-Appointed Seating

  • Heated & Ventilated Front Seats

  • Heated Second-Row Seats

  • Power Front Seats with Memory

  • Heated Leather-Wrapped Steering Wheel

  • Tri-Zone Automatic Climate Control

  • Power Tilt & Telescoping Steering Column

  • Power Sunroof

  • Power-Folding Third-Row Seats

  • Premium Wood Interior Trim

  • Ambient Interior Lighting

Step inside the Escalade Luxury and experience a cabin designed around premium comfort. Leather seating, elegant trim, soft-touch materials, and sophisticated detailing create a first-class atmosphere for both driver and passengers.

Heated and ventilated front seats provide year-round comfort, while heated second-row seating and tri-zone climate control help keep passengers comfortable throughout the cabin. The power-folding third row provides added versatility when additional cargo room is needed.

Technology & Infotainment

  • Cadillac CUE Infotainment System

  • 8-Inch Color Touchscreen

  • Built-In Navigation System

  • Bluetooth Hands-Free Calling

  • Bluetooth Audio Streaming

  • Bose Centerpoint Surround Sound System

  • SiriusXM Satellite Radio Capability

  • Wireless Phone Charging

  • USB Connectivity

  • Remote Engine Start

  • Push Button Start

  • Steering Wheel Mounted Controls

  • Rearview Backup Camera

Cadillac's CUE infotainment system puts entertainment, navigation, communication, and vehicle settings within easy reach. The premium Bose sound system provides exceptional audio quality throughout the cabin, while Bluetooth connectivity makes hands-free calling and wireless music streaming simple.

Remote Engine Start adds everyday convenience, especially during hot summers and cold winters.

Safety & Driver Assistance

  • Forward Collision Alert

  • Lane Keep Assist

  • Lane Departure Warning

  • Blind Zone Alert

  • Rear Cross Traffic Alert

  • Front & Rear Parking Sensors

  • Safety Alert Seat

  • Rearview Backup Camera

  • Automatic High-Beam Headlights

  • StabiliTrak Electronic Stability Control

  • Traction Control

  • Trailer Sway Control

  • Advanced Airbag Protection System

The Escalade Luxury offers an impressive selection of driver-assistance technologies designed to enhance awareness and confidence behind the wheel.

Front and rear parking sensors make maneuvering this full-size SUV easier, while Blind Zone Alert and Rear Cross Traffic Alert help monitor areas around the vehicle that may be difficult to see.

Cargo & Versatility

  • Three-Row Passenger Seating

  • Power-Folding Third-Row Seats

  • Foldable Second-Row Seating

  • Spacious Rear Cargo Area

  • Power Liftgate

  • Roof Rails

  • Multiple Interior Storage Compartments

  • Flexible Passenger & Cargo Configurations

The Escalade is designed to handle both passengers and cargo with ease. Fold the third row when additional storage space is needed for luggage, groceries, sporting equipment, or travel gear.

The power liftgate makes loading and unloading easier, while the flexible interior allows the Escalade to quickly adapt to changing passenger and cargo needs.

Exterior Features

  • Signature Cadillac Chrome Grille

  • Full LED Headlights

  • LED Daytime Running Lights

  • Signature Vertical LED Taillights

  • 22-Inch Premium Wheels

  • Power Sunroof

  • Heated Power-Folding Side Mirrors

  • Power Liftgate

  • Running Boards

  • Chrome Exterior Accents

  • Rear Privacy Glass

  • Bold Cadillac Luxury Styling

The 2016 Cadillac Escalade Luxury 4WD has an unmistakable presence on the road. Cadillac's signature grille, vertical LED lighting, premium wheels, chrome accents, and sculpted body lines give the Escalade an upscale and commanding appearance.

Its combination of bold styling and sophisticated detailing makes it one of the most recognizable luxury SUVs ever produced.

Highlights

  • 420 HP 6.2L V8 Engine

  • Four-Wheel Drive (4WD)

  • 8-Speed Automatic Transmission

  • Magnetic Ride Control

  • Premium Leather Interior

  • Heated & Ventilated Front Seats

  • Heated Second-Row Seats

  • Heated Steering Wheel

  • Power Sunroof

  • Built-In Navigation

  • Bose Premium Surround Sound

  • Remote Engine Start

  • Wireless Phone Charging

  • Front & Rear Parking Sensors

  • Blind Zone Alert

  • Power-Folding Third Row

  • Power Liftgate

  • 22-Inch Premium Wheels

Summary

The 2016 Cadillac Escalade Luxury 4WD delivers an outstanding combination of luxury, power, technology, and full-size SUV capability. With its 420-horsepower 6.2-liter V8, Four-Wheel Drive system, premium leather interior, heated and ventilated seating, navigation, Bose premium audio, sunroof, advanced safety technology, and three-row versatility, it's designed to provide a first-class experience on every drive.

Whether you're searching for a luxurious family SUV, a powerful towing vehicle, an all-weather daily driver, or a premium road-trip vehicle, the 2016 Cadillac Escalade Luxury 4WD offers the comfort, capability, and unmistakable Cadillac presence that make it a standout in the full-size luxury SUV market.

If you're in the market for a capable, full-size SUV that blends power, space, and style, this 2016 GMC Yukon SLT Sport Utility 4D for sale at Car Zone Auto Mall in South Gate, California is worth a serious look. With a commanding V8 engine, upscale SLT trim features, and the proven reliability that has made the Yukon a staple on American roads, this is the kind of vehicle that delivers for growing families, daily commuters, and weekend adventurers alike.
About This 2016 GMC Yukon SLT This 2016 GMC Yukon SLT comes in at 115,163 miles — a reasonable figure for a full-size SUV of this generation. The Yukon's body-on-frame construction and robust drivetrain components are engineered to go well beyond the 100K mark with proper maintenance, and many owners report these trucks running strong into the 200,000-mile range. Whether you're looking for a daily driver in the South Gate area or a long-haul family hauler, the Yukon SLT hits a sweet spot between luxury and practicality. Stock #39229300 is available now — reach out to Car Zone Auto Mall to schedule your visit.
2016 GMC Yukon Performance and Engine Under the hood of this Yukon SLT sits GM's legendary EcoTec3 5.3-liter V8 engine, paired with a heavy-duty 6-speed automatic transmission with overdrive. This powertrain combination produces 355 horsepower and 383 lb-ft of torque, giving you the muscle you need for hauling, towing, and confidently merging onto LA's busiest freeways.

The EcoTec3 V8 also features Active Fuel Management, which allows the engine to deactivate four of its eight cylinders during light-load cruising — improving fuel efficiency without sacrificing power when you need it. This 2WD configuration keeps weight low and delivers smooth, predictable handling across Southern California's roads and highways. The 6-speed automatic transmission shifts smoothly and intelligently, complementing the V8's broad torque band for an effortless driving experience.
GMC Yukon SLT Features and Interior The SLT trim is where the Yukon starts to feel genuinely premium. Expect an interior loaded with creature comforts and technology features that elevate every ride. The 2016 Yukon SLT typically includes leather-appointed seating surfaces, heated front seats, a power-adjustable driver's seat, and tri-zone automatic climate control to keep every passenger comfortable regardless of what the California sun is doing outside.

Technology and Connectivity

The SLT comes equipped with GMC's IntelliLink infotainment system featuring an 8-inch color touchscreen, Bluetooth audio and hands-free calling, Apple CarPlay-compatible navigation options, and a rear-view camera that makes parking this full-size SUV a far less stressful experience. Available rear-seat entertainment, a Bose premium audio system, and a power liftgate round out the tech package on well-equipped examples of this trim.

Space and Versatility

Three rows of seating and a cavernous cargo area make the Yukon SLT genuinely useful for families and anyone who regularly needs to move people and gear. With second-row seats folded, cargo capacity stretches to over 68 cubic feet — more than enough for costco runs, road trip luggage, or sports equipment.
GMC Yukon Reliability and Ownership The 2016 GMC Yukon has built a solid reputation among owners and industry analysts alike. The Quadra-Trac II 4WD system with Selec-Terrain delivers confident handling across various road conditions, supported by a four-wheel independent suspension and electronic stability control. Rain-sensitive windshield wipers automatically adjust to weather conditions, and the ParkView rear back-up camera simplifies parking and maneuvering.
